name: Aceternity UI

name: Spline

name: Godly

name: Mobbin

name: Picular

name: Storyset

name: Coolors

name: Fontjoy
description: An AI-powered typography tool that uses deep learning to generate balanced font pairings. It eliminates the guesswork of matching headlines with body copy by analyzing stylistic contrast and harmony.

name: Realtime Colors

name: Haikei
description: A unique SVG generator for creating abstract blobs, wave dividers, and low-poly backgrounds. It allows for infinite variations of vector shapes that can be downloaded for use in web design projects.

name: Shots
description: A minimalist mockup creation tool that turns standard screenshots into professional, clean presentation graphics. It offers various device frames and gradient backgrounds with high-resolution export options.

name: Squoosh
description: A high-performance image compression web app developed by Google that offers side-by-side visual comparison. It supports modern formats like WebP and AVIF with granular control over quality and size.

name: UI Colors

name: Open Doodles

name: Cursor

name: Supabase

name: Vercel
description: The frontend cloud platform optimized for Next.js and high-performance web deployment. it provides a seamless developer experience from local code to global production with automated CI/CD.

name: Resend
description: A modern email API platform designed specifically for developers. It features a best-in-class React Email integration, allowing for clean, component-based transactional emails with high deliverability.

name: PostHog

name: v0

name: Lovable

name: Ray.so
description: A developer utility that creates beautiful, high-resolution screenshots of code snippets with customizable syntax themes and gradient backgrounds. Perfect for sharing code on social media or docs.

name: Carbon

name: Regex101

name: Bundlephobia

name: JSON Crack
description: A visual data structure explorer that transforms complex JSON, YAML, and XML into interactive graph diagrams. It makes debugging large data payloads much more intuitive and readable.

name: Transform Tools

name: CodeSandbox

name: Biome

name: Bun

name: Mintlify
description: A modern documentation engine that turns codebase comments and MDX files into beautiful, high-performance docs. It focuses on developer experience and automated search integration.

name: Prisma

name: PlanetScale
description: A serverless MySQL database platform built for high-performance applications. It features advanced branching workflows and safe non-blocking schema changes for engineering teams.

name: Upstash

name: Clerk

name: Radio Garden

name: MyNoise
description: A sophisticated soundscape generator offering hundreds of professionally calibrated ambient background noises. It features multi-channel sliders to customize frequency balance for focus or relaxation.

name: Vocal Remover

name: Freesound

name: LALAL.AI

name: Soundtrap
description: A collaborative cloud-based digital audio workstation by Spotify. It provides a full studio environment for recording music, beatmaking, and podcast creation with real-time remote collaboration.

name: Lichess
description: A completely free, open-source online chess platform supported by community donations. It offers unlimited professional analysis, puzzles, and tournament play without advertisements or paywalls.

name: BoardGameGeek

name: Itch.io

name: Slow Roads

name: Piskel

name: Kenney

name: Lospec

name: Bfxr

name: Mixamo

name: Linear

name: Notion

name: Obsidian
description: A private, extensible knowledge management app that works on a local folder of plain text Markdown files. it helps users build a personal knowledge graph using bi-directional links.

name: Goblin.tools
description: An AI-assisted productivity suite designed specifically for neurodivergent individuals. it features tools to break down daunting tasks, formalize emails, and estimate the true time required for a task.

name: TinyWow
description: A comprehensive suite of free, single-purpose file utilities. it allows users to convert PDFs, edit images, and compress video files instantly in the browser without registration or watermarks.

name: Loom

name: Milanote
description: A visual workspace designed for creative projects. it allows users to organize research, moodboards, and task lists on an infinite board that feels more like a physical creative studio.

name: Maildrop
description: A free, high-performance disposable email address system. it allows for custom inbox names to bypass sign-up walls and newsletter trackers while keeping personal data completely hidden.

name: McMaster-Carr

name: Hackaday
description: A daily editorial journal and project showcase for the global engineering community. it documents ingenious hardware hacks, reverse engineering feats, and unconventional physical computing builds.

description: A high-performance CAD software optimized for mobile and multi-device workflows. it features an intuitive direct modeling engine that makes professional 3D engineering accessible on tablets.

name: AllTrails
description: A comprehensive trail guide database featuring over 400,000 curated maps for hiking, biking, and running. it provides real-time community conditions, verified photos, and GPS navigation data.

description: A multi-engine malware analysis service that inspects suspicious files, domains, and IP addresses. it aggregates results from dozens of antivirus engines and threat intelligence feeds instantly.

name: Exploit Database
description: A CVE-compliant archive that logs public exploits and vulnerable software disclosures. it serves as a vital verification database for penetration testers and defenders verifying defense systems.

name: Roadmap.sh
description: An interactive library of visual learning paths for modern software engineering roles. it provides step-by-step guides on mastering the technologies required for frontend, backend, and DevOps careers.

name: Exercism
description: A free coding platform offering over 4,000 language-specific exercises across 67 programming languages. it provides personalized human mentorship and automated feedback to help developers reach fluency.

name: Connected Papers

name: Consensus

name: Brilliant
description: An interactive learning platform that teaches STEM concepts through gamified, first-principles problem solving. it focuses on deep conceptual understanding of computer science, math, and physics.

name: CoinGecko
